description: A/B experiment declarations for the eval-evidence promotion decision layer (issue #192; epic #148). Variants carry the traffic split (relative `weight`, normalized at read time) plus the subject under test (model / promptRef / engine flags); `metric` names the eval evidence the arms are compared on. Lifecycle status here is the desired state — promotions and rollbacks the evaluator applies live in the state file (AI_SDLC_AB_STATE / --state), never in this committed config.

experiments.description: Candidate model vs the declared model.primary, gated on the functional eval suite pass rate. Draft: declared for wiring; no live traffic is routed by this repo — the decision layer consumes eval result artifacts only.
